Iluvatar CoreX.why: Chinese GPGPU designer whose TG (training) and ZK (inference) accelerators made up 96.9% of H1 2026 revenue; its stock rises and falls with domestic AI accelerator demand.
Iluvatar CoreX.evidence: We are a leading provider of GPGPU products and AI computing solutions in China. ... Revenue from GPGPU products reached RMB916.1 million, representing a year-on-year increase of 231.0% and accounting for 96.9% of total revenue.

players.product: GPGPU accelerators: TG series training chips (TG Gen 4 flagship), ZK series inference chips, Tongyang edge computing products and AI computing solutions

quarterly_data.quarter: Iluvatar CoreX press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 interim results (six months ended June 30, 2026): revenue RMB945.7 million vs RMB324.3 million, up 191.6%; gross profit flat at RMB162.6 million (RMB162.4 million a year earlier) as gross margin fell from 50.1% to 17.2%, hit by a RMB72.2 million write-down of work-in-progress inventories under a new market and product strategy and a gross loss on server components sold to certain customers below procurement cost; profit for the period RMB106.3 million vs a loss of RMB609.3 million, a turnaround primarily due to unrealized fair value gains (RMB760.2 million) on its shareholding in SJ Semiconductor Corporation; adjusted net profit (non-HKFRS) RMB246.0 million vs an adjusted net loss of RMB299.8 million. R&D costs rose 23.8% to RMB558.9 million on higher material consumption and tape-out expenses and a larger R&D team.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue RMB945.7 million (+191.6%); gross margin 50.1% to 17.2%; profit RMB106.3 million (loss RMB609.3 million a year earlier); adjusted net profit RMB246.0 million; R&D RMB558.9 million (+23.8%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Iluvatar CoreX press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: GPGPU products revenue RMB916.1 million, up 231.0% and 96.9% of total revenue, with GPGPU gross profit RMB401.8 million (+188.5%) and GPGPU gross margin 43.9% (50.3% a year earlier, product-mix shift). Training series (TG) revenue RMB261.9 million (+38.0%) on AI-industry demand, gross margin up from 58.6% to 64.5% on more advanced, higher-priced products. Inference series (ZK) revenue RMB654.2 million (+651.8%), driven by a surge in AI inference demand and robust sales of an advanced ZK version that lifted both sales volume and selling price; inference gross margin 32.4% to 35.6%. AI computing solutions revenue fell 68.1% to RMB13.6 million, which the company attributes to coordination of supply resources, adjusted project delivery schedules and a strategic shift of focus to GPGPU products in response to prevailing market supply and demand conditions.
quarterly_data.figure: GPGPU RMB916.1 million (+231.0%, 96.9% of revenue); TG training RMB261.9 million (+38.0%); ZK inference RMB654.2 million (+651.8%); AI computing solutions RMB13.6 million (-68.1%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Iluvatar CoreX press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: In July 2026 the company released TG Gen 4, its new-generation flagship, on a SIMT general computing architecture supporting scalar, vector and tensor computation and optimized for Attention, MoE, AF separation, PD separation and large-scale system expansion. In January 2026 it released a four-generation architecture roadmap and launched the Tongyang series of edge-side computing products (CPU and GPU computing with high-speed interfaces) for industrial, commercial and transportation intelligence.

quarterly_data.quarter: Iluvatar CoreX press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Roadmap (company plans): R&D of the next-generation TG series is progressing as planned, aimed at better efficiency and cluster expansion including SuperPod; next-generation ZK products are being optimized for the latest large language models with expanded low-precision data types and mixed-precision computing; the company will increase investment in rack-level SuperPod R&D (integrated rack-level design, high-speed interconnection, efficient power supply and thermal management). Its proprietary communication library improved cross-node communication efficiency by approximately 30% and stably supports 10,000-card clusters; more than 650 mainstream algorithm models have been adapted through its DeepSpark open-source community.
quarterly_data.figure: cross-node communication efficiency up approximately 30%; 10,000-card clusters; more than 650 models adapted

quarterly_data.quarter: Iluvatar CoreX press release: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended June (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customers and demand: as of June 30, 2026 the group had served over 380 customers, with scaled deployment across Internet, AI large models, financial services, healthcare, scientific research and other sectors. Management outlook: leading Internet and AI companies continue to deploy large-scale training clusters, driving strong demand for high-performance training chips, and industrial transformation presents strategic opportunities for domestic GPU enterprises in domestic substitution; it plans deeper cooperation with Internet companies, cloud service providers, AI model companies and research institutions. Inventories rose to RMB1,968,061 thousand at June 30, 2026 from RMB709,765 thousand at December 31, 2025, and trade payables to RMB827,176 thousand from RMB31,129 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: over 380 customers; inventories RMB1,968,061 thousand (RMB709,765 thousand at end-2025)
